mechanism: Persistent complete physical registry/common2D Flatbush and bounded conservative0.25mm query envelopes. Exact native expanded-Float64-AABB filtering precedes native selected-owner/frozen/layer/drill policies and distance. Cached primitives have no ownership/frozen metadata; nearby, reversed and layer queries may share physical candidates.
invalidation: Both old and new expanded physical AABBs stamp globally monotonic revisions in1mm cells. Each entry checks the maximum revision across its FULL envelope. Any changed primitive intersecting that envelope shares a cell with newer revision. Cell/reference limits, unsafe revision/floor bounds clear entries/reset epoch. Traversal uses bounded integer offsets.
ordering: Native cellX/cellY hit sorting followed by spanIndex/primitiveIndex retains the relative order of native filtered-copper insertion indexes. Native FindClearancePathSolver, budgets, phase steps and floating accumulation are unchanged.
memory: 16384 slots with4 exact envelope bounds per key,131072 retained candidate references,32768 stamped cells,4096-cell stamp/query traversal cap. Large queries observe global revision; oversized lists are queried without retention. Geometry/index scale with current physical primitives. candidateSlotsReserved counts slots, not JS heap bytes.

boundedSample14.limits: First naturally constructed region,20-search observational prefix only; no elapsed timing or whole-board quality claim.

validation: Five focused tests pass, including native step/output/search parity, same-net holes on disjoint blind spans, variable widths, through_obstacle, old/new moves/removals, full-envelope reuse, memory/reset and huge coordinates. Independent reviewer additionally checked36004 brute AABB cases and4 physical parity cases. Typecheck/package build checked separately.
decision: Freeze for independent Blacksmith pilot. No performance/quality promotion without whole-board outputs, physical results and total timings.
diagnostics: Per-query/revision-cell/bbox/distance counters are opt-in; production defaultfalse. Stable native stats unchanged. Setup/index counters outside stats.
